## Où j'en suis

Fernhill SAML SSO works end to end on staging: real login with their IdP succeeds after the RelayState fix, JIT provisioning (PR #415, merged) creates users as viewer, and group-to-role mapping is in open PR #421. Waiting on Fernhill IT to add the groups claim before the demo, Thursday Nov 19 10:00 ET; go-live Dec 1. (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/platform#421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" is open (commits 6d0e2b8, f4a91c7); full suite green (1301 passed, 3 skipped). (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#421, ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Fernhill IT adds the groups claim to the assertion (task still a_faire); Daniel emails them today. Then create one admin test account for the demo. (source: ses-sso-3)
- [essai-raté] Sending the full return URL (143 bytes) as RelayState was rejected by their ADFS (MSIS7042, 80-byte cap); replaced by a 22-char opaque ID with the URL in Redis, TTL 600 s. Earlier, JIT tests failed on email case vs lowercase domain list; domains normalized to lowercase. (source: ses-sso-3, ses-sso-2)
- [question] Fernhill IT asked via Slack for IdP-initiated only, analyst as default role, and the groups claim only after the demo; you refused both for now, Maya is to talk to them, so this may come back. (source: src-slack-fernhill, ses-sso-3)
- [décision] Viewer stays the default role (no analyst role exists) and SP-initiated login stays on for the fernhill tenant. (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Per-tenant group mapping: Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins → admin, everything else viewer, applied on every login. (source: s3-05, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)
- [décision] RelayState: short
